The "Banana Sandwich" in just Ten easy steps!

Ingredients: 1 Banana 1/2 teaspoon Mayo 2 pieces of raw toast(bread) Dash of sugar(optional)

1) Peel one banana. 2) Insert banana into a bowl and smoosh with fork or other tool of choice. 3) Add mayo to smooshed banana. 4) Blend evenly. 5) Apply delicious banamayo paste to one side of a single piece of bread. 5.5) Now is the time to dash with sugar if you'd like. 6) Place the second piece of bread on top of the concoction like you would a star to a Christmas tree. 7) Insert into mouth. 8) Chew vigorously. 9) Savor flavor. 10) Wash down with Cherry Koolaid

Enjoy! 👌

I grew up with this, man...in my house, though, we never smooshed the banana. We cut it up into slices about 1/4 inch thick or sliced it longways, put the mayo on the bread, and a little black pepper.
